record.site_desc: Newly established site in 2026 on a gently sloping. poor fen muskeg (wetland) on the south-east coastline of Douglas Island, near Juneau, AK. The wider ecoregion is the perhumid (always wet) zone of the Northeast Pacific coastal temperate rainforest. The fen vegetation includes sphagnum mosses and other short-statured herbacious species (< 30 cm). Open water ponds scatter the wider muskeg clearning but none are contained in the intended footprint of the fen EC system.

grp_location.location_comment: Poor fen muskeg on southern Douglas Island near Ready Bullion Creek / Bullion Creek, gently sloping eastward toward Gastineau Channel. Coordinates mark the EC tripod base. Co-located biomet tower ~20 m at 135-degrees (SE) of the flux tower.

grp_igbp.igbp_comment: Open poor fen (sloping peatland) with higher vascular plant diversity than typical Sphagnum-dominated bog; scattered stunted/dead trees (shore pine / yellow-cedar influence); permanent wetland character within AK coatsal temperate rainforest hydro-pedological mosaic of upland forest, forested wetlands, and poor fens.
